selected_evidence.requirement: C.UTF-8 is installed, valid, and configured as the system default
selected_evidence.summary: The locale archive contains C.utf8, C.UTF-8 resolves to the UTF-8 charmap, and both localectl and /etc/locale.conf report LANG=C.UTF-8 after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: New login sessions default to C.UTF-8
selected_evidence.summary: Clean login-session probes before and after reboot reported LANG=C.UTF-8 and UTF-8 charmap.
A newly launched post-reboot systemd service reported LANG=C.UTF-8, no overriding LC_ALL, and UTF-8 charmap.

Healthy baseline boot ID 192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2 was captured, the reboot timer was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 48773003-93cb-4cbf-8439-646bb7684b9b, systemd running, zero failed units, and locale behavior recovered.
Final state is running with zero failed units, LANG=C.UTF-8 in configuration and the systemd manager, and UTF-8 active.
